notes.title: Improve Experience
notes.notes: Improve UI experience and refine text readability.

notes.title: Added the cube status saving function
notes.notes: When click the “main menu” button in the play menu, it will save the cube status and back to start screen, so you can continue when you play next time. if you want to make the cube random again, click the "restart" button.

notes.title: Add the option to set keyboard key binds
notes.notes: You can modify keyboard key binds right now.

notes.title: Update On January 30th : Improved mouse control experience
notes.notes: Improved mouse control experience, no matter what the tilt Angle, you can use the mouse to drag the block to a certain direction.
